company.name: Colexion
company.shortDescription: Colexion is a blockchain-based non-fungible token (NFT) marketplace.
company.description: Colexion is a premium GameFi ecosystem that looks to enrich user experience through the utility of Cards. Along with it, our marketplace brings celebrities together on a single platform, allowing them to create more Cards and feel more connected with their fans. Being the leading licensed Gaming Marketplace, Colexion’s suite of Web 3.0 enables creators to choose and embed licences while minting. We have teamed up with profound celebrities and artists to create a collection of limited edition, high-quality Cards, that are exclusively available on our platform. We, at Colexion, cater to the world of Sports, Entertainment, Music and specialise in features such as the marketplace and Play-to-Earn cricket gaming.
